name: LocalBitcoins

descriptions.text: LocalBitcoins has detected a security vulnerability - an unauthorised source was able to access and send transactions from a number of affected accounts.It was related to a feature powered by a third party software, and stop the attack. At the moment, we are determining the correct number of users affected - so far six cases have been confirmed.

LocalBitcoins suffered a security breach on January 26, 2019, after attackers used a forum-based phishing scheme to steal 7.95 BTC (about $27,000) from at least six user accounts. The exploit stemmed from a vulnerability in third-party forum software, allowing redirection to a fraudulent login page that captured credentials and two-factor codes. Attackers exploited a vulnerability in LocalBitcoins' third-party forum software, redirecting users to a phishing site that captured login and 2FA credentials, enabling unauthorized withdrawals from user accounts.
